errors.message: The agent runner could not be started: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af doctor' to check that the runner and its browsers are installed.

errors.message: Workflow {workflow} exhausted its budget of {budget} before completing.
errors.resolution: Raise the budget for {workflow} in the manifest, or split it into smaller workflows.

errors.message: The agent runner produced no readable output: {detail}
errors.resolution: This is the runner's own failure and not the application's; the output above is what it printed.

errors.message: The agent runner could not be found: {detail}
errors.resolution: Install it with 'af runner install', or point at a checkout with --runner.

errors.message: The {provider} key was not accepted: {detail}
errors.resolution: {next_step}

errors.message: The {provider} endpoint could not be reached: {detail}
errors.resolution: {next_step}

errors.message: No workflow reached a verdict about the application: {detail}
errors.resolution: Read the workflow rows above for what stopped each one. A run that verified nothing is not a passing run, and 'policy.workflows_unverified: warn' records the choice if the project has no workflows yet.

errors.message: Invariant {invariant} did not finish within {timeout}.
errors.resolution: Make the invariant cheaper; it runs after every workflow and must be a quick read.

errors.message: Invariant {invariant} is not read only.
errors.resolution: Rewrite it as a single SELECT; invariants run inside a read only transaction.

errors.message: Invariant {invariant} does not hold: {detail}
errors.resolution: The rows the statement returned are the violation. Run it against the branch to see them all.

errors.message: There is nothing to explore: {detail}
errors.resolution: Add a goal under explore in the manifest, and set explore.enabled to true.

errors.message: No goal named {goal} is declared under explore.
errors.resolution: Run 'af explain' to see the goals this manifest declares, then check the spelling.

errors.message: The build for service {service} failed after {duration}.
errors.resolution: Read the build log above; the first error line names the step that failed.

errors.message: The Dockerfile for {service} is not valid at line {line}: {detail}
errors.resolution: Fix the line and run 'af up' again.

errors.message: The build context for {service} is {size}, above the {limit} limit.
errors.resolution: Add large directories to .dockerignore; the build does not need them.

errors.message: The build context for {service} holds more than {count} files; {path} is where the count was reached.
errors.resolution: Add the generated directories to .dockerignore; a build context should hold source, not output.

errors.message: The build for service {service} failed after {duration}, and its Dockerfile is {dockerfile} inside a build context rooted at the repository.
errors.resolution: If the Dockerfile expects to be built from its own directory, which is what 'docker build {dir}' does, set build.context to {dir} for this service. Otherwise read the build log above; the first error line names the step that failed.

errors.message: No build strategy could be detected for {service}.
errors.resolution: Add a Dockerfile to {path}, or set services.{service}.build to a strategy the reference lists.

errors.message: The Dockerfile {dockerfile} for {service} is excluded from the build context by .dockerignore.
errors.resolution: Add '!{dockerfile}' to .dockerignore. The file exists, and the build sends a filtered copy of the tree to the daemon, so a path the ignore file excludes is not there to build from.

errors.message: The Dockerfile {dockerfile} for {service} is outside the build context {context}.
errors.resolution: Widen build.context, or move the Dockerfile inside it. A build cannot read a file the context does not carry.

errors.message: The control plane could not complete this request.
errors.resolution: Retry once. If it fails again, quote the requestId the response carries: it is the only thing that ties the answer to a log line.

errors.message: No control plane token is configured.
errors.resolution: Run 'af login' then 'af token create ci', and set AF_CONTROL_PLANE_TOKEN to what it prints. Everything except this command works without one.

errors.message: The control plane has no environment called {env}.
errors.resolution: Check the identifier with 'af env list', or confirm the engine that created it was sending events to this control plane.

errors.message: This machine is not signed in to {origin}.
errors.resolution: Run '{command}' to sign in from this terminal. Nothing else in the engine needs a sign in; only the commands that read or write your own account do.

errors.message: The source database at {host} could not be reached.
errors.resolution: Check that the host is reachable from this machine and that the connection string names the right port.

errors.message: The source database is Postgres {found}, and this provider supports {supported}.
errors.resolution: Set database.version to one of {supported} if the source is one of those, or point database.provider at one that handles Postgres {found}. The docker provider builds a golden in the stock postgres image, so it handles every major that image is published for.

errors.message: The golden version {version} no longer exists.
errors.resolution: Run 'af golden list' to see what exists, or 'af golden refresh' to make one. 'af up' chooses a version itself.

errors.message: The golden version {version} is still referenced by {count} environments and cannot be collected.
errors.resolution: Run 'af down' on those environments first, or leave the version in place.

errors.message: The provider's concurrent branch limit ({limit}) is reached.
errors.resolution: Run 'af down' on unused environments or raise the limit in the provider settings.

errors.message: The database provider {provider} at {endpoint} rejected the configured credential.
errors.resolution: Check the value of the variable named by database.api_key_env; the provider answered 401, so the credential reached it and was refused rather than being missing.

errors.message: The Database Lab Engine at {endpoint} has no snapshot to build a golden from: {detail}
errors.resolution: Wait for the engine's own data retrieval to finish, then refresh again; its progress is at GET /instance/retrieval.

errors.message: The subset could not be taken: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af explain' to see the effective subset block, and check that the seed table and its predicate name columns this database has.

errors.message: No golden here was made for this project, and {count} were made for something else.
errors.resolution: Run 'af golden refresh' to make one from the source this manifest names. A golden is chosen by the project it was made for, the database it was copied from, the masking rules, the subset and the Postgres version, so one belonging to another project on this machine is never branched here.

errors.message: The database seed command failed: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run the command yourself against an empty database of the same version. It is: {command}

errors.message: No database branch exists for {env}.
errors.resolution: Run 'af up' to create one. This is not a missing golden: nothing has been branched for this environment yet.

errors.message: The published golden {version} in {store} was made for a different project.
errors.resolution: Name a version this project published with 'af golden pull <version>', or run 'af golden refresh' on a machine that can reach the source. A store is shared, so the newest object in it is not necessarily yours.

errors.message: database.source_url_env names {variable}, and no configured source has a value for it.
errors.resolution: Put the read only connection string of the database to copy in one of the searched sources: export {variable} in this shell, add it to .env, or run 'af secret set {variable}'. To build a golden with no production behind it, remove database.source_url_env and set database.seed instead.

errors.message: Personas cannot be provisioned because {provider} creates users only through its own API, and no sandbox tenant is configured.
errors.resolution: Point auth.url or auth.domain at a sandbox, development or staging tenant and set auth.sandbox: true, so that personas are never created in production.

errors.message: {provider} rejected the admin token used to create personas.
errors.resolution: Check that the variable named by auth.token_env holds a key for the sandbox tenant with permission to create users.

errors.message: No table that looks like a users table was found, so there is nowhere to create the personas that sign in.
errors.resolution: Name the table with auth.table if it is there under a name this did not recognise, use auth.adapter: seed to have the personas seeded instead, or give a persona 'login: none' if it never signs in, in which case no account is needed.

errors.message: Migrations failed on the branch: {detail}
errors.resolution: The rehearsal names the statement that failed and times the ones before it. Fix the migration and push again: a migration that fails on a branch with production's shape is one that would have failed in production.

errors.message: The migration finding {rule} fails this project's policy: {detail}
errors.resolution: The report above names the table and the statement. Fix the migration, or lower the rule to 'warn' in the manifest's policy block.

errors.message: The previous release does not survive this migration: {detail}
errors.resolution: A rolling deploy runs both releases at once, so make the change backward compatible: add the new column and write to both, migrate the readers, and drop the old one in a later deploy.

errors.message: No application could be detected in {path}.
errors.resolution: Declare your services by hand in antifailure.yaml; the manifest reference lists the minimum fields.

errors.message: Detection could not decide {question}, and there is no default to fall back on.
errors.resolution: Answer it with --answer {id}=<value>, or run 'af init' from a terminal so it can ask.

errors.message: Detection produced a draft that is not a valid manifest, so nothing was written and {path} does not exist: {detail}
errors.resolution: Re-run with --answer to override what detection read, for example --answer service.<name>.port=<port>. If nothing in the repository is wrong, this is a defect in Antifailure and worth reporting with the detail above.

errors.message: --answer {id}=... does not name anything in this repository.
errors.resolution: Use one of: {known}

errors.message: The changed files between {base} and {head} could not be read: {detail}
errors.resolution: Fetch the base branch before running 'af change'. A checkout cloned one commit deep shares no history with it, which is what 'fetch-depth: 0' fixes in a GitHub Actions job.

errors.message: The diff at {path} could not be read: {detail}
errors.resolution: Produce it with 'git diff --unified=0 base...head'; this reads git's own unified format and nothing else.

errors.message: The license covers {seats} seats and they are all in use.
errors.resolution: Remove an inactive member, or ask for more seats at https://antifailure.dev/contact. No existing member was removed.

errors.message: Organization policy {policy} refuses this environment: {detail}
errors.resolution: Ask an organization administrator to review {policy}, or bring the repository into compliance.

errors.message: The environment does not reproduce {dimension}, which the manifest requires: {detail}
errors.resolution: Fix what the inventory names, or remove {dimension} from fidelity.require.

errors.message: {dimension} is required and could not be measured, so it is neither met nor broken: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af fidelity' to see what could not be measured, and fix that before trusting the requirement.

errors.message: Nothing ran, because of the fork policy on the base branch. {detail}
errors.resolution: Add the antifailure:allow label to the pull request, or change github.fork_policy on the base branch.

errors.message: The provider rate limited this operation and asked to wait {retry_after}.
errors.resolution: The engine retries automatically. If this persists, lower the concurrency in the manifest.

errors.message: Load could not be generated: {detail}
errors.resolution: Bring the environment up with 'af up', and check the load section of the manifest.

errors.message: Load exceeded {count} thresholds the manifest sets.
errors.resolution: The breaches are listed above, worst first. Raise the threshold or fix the regression.

errors.message: There is no load source called {source}.
errors.resolution: Use otel for an OpenTelemetry trace export, access_log for a combined format log, or none. Both file sources read source_config.path.

errors.message: The scenario at {path} could not be read: {detail}
errors.resolution: Fix the document, then run 'af doctor' to revalidate the manifest.

errors.message: {count} scenario assertions did not hold.
errors.resolution: Each one is listed above with what it measured. Fix the regression, or change what the scenario asks for.

errors.message: The scenario {scenario} proved nothing: {detail}
errors.resolution: A scenario is blocked when a route it sends is not named in load.safe_routes, and unverified when an assertion names a step that nothing sent. Both are fixed in the manifest or in the scenario document.

errors.message: The p95_increase threshold proved nothing: {detail}
errors.resolution: The threshold divides a measured p95 by production's own p95 for that route, and only a trace export carries one. Read the traffic with source: otel, or judge the run on error_rate alone.

errors.message: No antifailure.yaml was found in {path} or any parent directory.
errors.resolution: Run 'af init' in the repository root to create one.

errors.message: The manifest at {path} is not valid: {detail}
errors.resolution: Fix the reported line, then run 'af doctor' to revalidate.

errors.message: The manifest at {path} declares schema version {found}, which this build does not understand.
errors.resolution: Check the build you are running with 'af version' and install the release that supports version {found}.

errors.message: 'af init' has questions to ask and this session has no terminal to ask them on.
errors.resolution: Pass --non-interactive to accept every default, and --answer id=value for anything that has no default.

errors.message: The manifest at {path} is larger than the {limit} limit.
errors.resolution: Split the configuration or remove generated content; a manifest describes services, it does not contain them.

errors.message: The golden {version} has no valid verification attestation and cannot be branched.
errors.resolution: Run 'af golden verify {version}'; a golden is branchable only once verification has passed.

errors.message: Verification found data matching {detector} in {table}.{column}.
errors.resolution: Add a masking rule for {table}.{column} and refresh the golden. The value itself is never printed.

errors.message: Masking could not run: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af mask plan' to see what was decided for each column.

errors.message: Verification could not read {table}.{column}, so the golden was not verified: {detail}
errors.resolution: Grant the scanner read access to {table}.{column} and refresh the golden. A column the scan could not read is not a column that passed.

errors.message: The request to {host} was blocked by rule {rule}.
errors.resolution: Add an egress rule for {host} with the mode you intend, or leave it blocked.

errors.message: {request} is not a request that can be explained: {detail}
errors.resolution: Pass a method and a URL, as in 'af net explain GET https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges'.

errors.message: No mock matched {method} {path} on {host}.
errors.resolution: A fixture skeleton was written to {suggestion}. Fill it in and run again.

errors.message: No message matching {match} arrived within {timeout}.
errors.resolution: Check 'af net log' to see whether the request was refused, and 'af inbox list' for what did arrive.

errors.message: The webhook could not be delivered to {service}: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af status' to check the service is up, and check the path against the manifest's webhook_path.

errors.message: The environment tried to reach {hosts}, which nothing in the manifest mentions.
errors.resolution: Add an egress rule for it with the mode you intend, or set policy.egress_surprise to 'warn' to let the attempt through the check.

errors.message: The manifest declares no oracle block, so there is nothing to compare.
errors.resolution: Add an oracle block with at least one probe; the manifest reference has the shape.

errors.message: The oracle is on and declares no requests to send.
errors.resolution: Add at least one entry under oracle.probes. Both versions have to receive the same requests in the same order, so the plan is written down rather than discovered.

errors.message: The baseline revision could not be resolved: {detail}
errors.resolution: Set oracle.base_ref to a branch, tag, or commit this checkout can see, and fetch it if it is a remote ref.

errors.message: The baseline and the candidate are both {commit}, so there is nothing to compare.
errors.resolution: Commit the change, or point oracle.base_ref at the revision you meant to compare against.

errors.message: The baseline revision {commit} could not be checked out: {detail}
errors.resolution: Check that the commit is present in this clone; a shallow clone often is not deep enough to reach it.

errors.message: There is no web service to send requests to in the {side} environment.
errors.resolution: Declare a service of kind web in the manifest; the oracle compares HTTP responses and needs somewhere to send them.

errors.message: The baseline environment did not come up: {detail}
errors.resolution: Bring the baseline revision up on its own with 'af up' from a checkout of it to see the build or migration failure in full.

errors.message: The {side} branch could not be read for comparison: {detail}
errors.resolution: Check the branch is reachable, or turn the contents comparison off with oracle.database.enabled: false to compare responses alone.

errors.message: The golden version {version} the comparison pinned is no longer present or no longer verified.
errors.resolution: Run the comparison again; both sides branch one golden and the one the candidate used has gone.

errors.message: The candidate behaves differently from the baseline: {detail}
errors.resolution: Read the differences above. Each one is either the change you meant to make or a regression; raise oracle.fail_on if this class of difference is expected.

errors.message: The command '{command}' is not available in this version.
errors.resolution: See the roadmap for when it lands; 'af version' reports the version you are running.

errors.message: The Docker daemon at {endpoint} could not be reached.
errors.resolution: Start Docker and run 'af doctor' to confirm; on macOS that is Docker Desktop.

errors.message: Another Antifailure process holds the lock for this branch (process {pid}, since {since}).
errors.resolution: Wait for it to finish, or stop it and run 'af down' to clean up.

errors.message: Service {service} did not become ready within {timeout}.
errors.resolution: The last log lines are above. Check the health path {health} and the port the service binds.

errors.message: Service {service} exited with code {code} during startup.
errors.resolution: The last log lines are above. Run 'af logs {service}' for the full output.

errors.message: No free port was found in the range {range} to publish the environment on.
errors.resolution: Free a port in that range, or set AF_PORT_RANGE_START to the first port of a range that is clear.

errors.message: Writing to {path} failed because the disk is full; {needed} is required.
errors.resolution: Free space on the volume holding {path}, then run the command again.

errors.message: Docker has no room left for the environment: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'docker system prune' or raise the disk limit in Docker's settings.

errors.message: The environment could not be torn down completely; {count} resources are still recorded.
errors.resolution: Run 'af down' again once the provider is reachable; the journal remembers what is left.

errors.message: The environment could not be placed: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af doctor' to check the runtime, then 'af down' to clear anything left behind.

errors.message: The services depend on each other in a cycle: {cycle}
errors.resolution: Remove one of the depends_on entries; a cycle has no order that can start.

errors.message: Service {service} depends on {missing}, which the manifest does not declare.
errors.resolution: Add a service called {missing}, or correct the depends_on entry.

errors.message: This cluster is not containing the environment: {detail}
errors.resolution: Use a cluster whose CNI enforces NetworkPolicy rather than only accepting it, then run 'af up' again.

errors.message: This runtime cannot do that: {detail}
errors.resolution: Use the runtime that supports it, or run the command against an environment placed by one that does.

errors.message: {kind} {name} was not created by this runtime, so it was not removed.
errors.resolution: Remove it yourself if you meant to, or use an environment id this runtime placed. 'af env list' shows the ones it owns.

errors.message: AF_PORT_RANGE_START is set to {value}, which is not a port number.
errors.resolution: Set it to the first port of a free range, between {limit}, or unset it to use the default.

errors.message: The variables {names} are declared in the manifest but were not found in any configured source.
errors.resolution: Add them to one of the searched sources: {sources}.

errors.message: The credential for {source} was rejected after one refresh: {detail}
errors.resolution: Rotate the credential and store the new value where {source} reads it. A rejection that survives a refresh is a credential that was revoked or was never right, so retrying will not help.

errors.message: The value supplied for {name} carries a live credential prefix, and {name} is configured for sandbox use.
errors.resolution: Point {name} at a sandbox credential; the environment must never hold a live key.

errors.message: The encrypted local store has no passphrase: no system keyring answered and AF_SECRET_PASSPHRASE is not set.
errors.resolution: Set AF_SECRET_PASSPHRASE, or store the passphrase in the system keyring on a platform that has one. There is deliberately no default: a store encrypted with a passphrase everybody knows only looks encrypted.

errors.message: The variable {name} could not be looked up: {detail}
errors.resolution: Fix the source named in the message, or export {name} in this shell, which is the first source the chain reads and beats the one that failed.

errors.message: The environment certificate could not be created: {detail}
errors.resolution: Run 'af doctor' to check the runtime, then bring the environment up again.

errors.message: There is no workload kind called {kind}.
errors.resolution: Use one of {known}, spelled the way the control plane spells it.

errors.message: The {kind} kind cannot set {knobs}.
errors.resolution: Remove it from the workload version. The command that kind runs has no flag for it, so honouring it would be a promise the run cannot keep.

errors.message: The {knob} value {value} is not what this workload's command takes: {detail}
errors.resolution: Correct the value in the workload version, then run it again.

errors.message: The {kind} kind must name what it runs: {detail}
errors.resolution: List the scenarios or goals the workload selects, by the names the manifest declares.

errors.message: The exploration {exploration} cannot be promoted: {detail}
errors.resolution: Promote an exploration that reached its goal. One that was blocked has no journey to compile.

errors.message: These two workload results cannot be compared: {detail}
errors.resolution: Compare two runs of the same workload kind. A mix and a browser workflow measure different things and a difference between them would be arithmetic on unlike numbers.

errors.message: The workload found a failure: {detail}
errors.resolution: The result document above names what failed. Reproduce it with the command it carries.

errors.message: The workload proved nothing: {detail}
errors.resolution: A run that measured nothing is not a run that found nothing. The result says which routes were refused or which selection matched no declared name.

errors.message: The workload did not finish: {detail}
errors.resolution: The environment was torn down where the run asked for it. Run it again, or raise the deadline.
